movie.title: To Catch a Thief
movie.tagline: WANTED by the police in all the luxury-spots of Europe!... A catch for any woman!
movie.overview: When a string of jewel robberies hits the French Riviera, suspicion falls on retired thief John “The Cat” Robie. To clear his name, he sets out to trap the copycat himself—entangling a wealthy widow and her beguiling daughter in a seductive game of pursuit, deception, and desire.
